source_boundaries: Scalar host register configuration and independent LPDDR4 encodings only. accepted_root_decisions.counter_qualification: Explicit T736 host-interface assumption corresponding to CK/4, corroborated by current clock configuration. Not generalized to all controller field families or other chips.
accepted_root_decisions.TMGCFG: Set only TIMING+0xd00 bit0 to select1:4; preserve all other bits. This was0 on both channels and is a separate quasi-dynamic field from global INITTMG.
accepted_root_decisions.latencies: Retain existing RL36/WL18/nWR40 and the accepted64-write subset; final fitted-device/frequency qualification remains unresolved.
accepted_root_decisions.micro_reset: Caller must explicitly freeze expectedMicro=1 or9. MicroReset bit0 is StallToMicro and bit3 is ResetToMicro: 1 releases reset while retaining stall; 9 retains reset and stall. Both prohibit ARC execution through stall; this component never changes the PHY.

pure_profile.interpretation: Timer fields and MR images are configuration only. INITMR2/3 do not guarantee automatic-init transmission of MR11/12/22/14. MR13 bit3 isVRCG; DM-disable bit5 remains clear.

transaction.before_any_write: Validate clock/domain/timer configuration, zero common ports, both controllers heldINIT, SWCTL/SWSTAT1, staticunlock0, MRCTRL0=0x30/MRSTAT0, PHY owner0, selectedMicro, clocks3, MemResetL2 and ZCalReset/Run0. Read and validate all14 prospective configuration fields before either channel changes.
write_order: SWCTL=0 on both channels with bounded SWSTAT0

transaction.failure_policy: Stop immediately; do not issue cleanup or retry. Record read/write attempts and completions, last operation and values, channel completion and conservative maybe-open masks. A failed callback can have changed hardware. Host owns recovery from a stalled bus.
transaction.success_code: T736_INIT_CONFIGURED_ONLY=1, not DDR initialization or training success
